'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]
***[[Panjshir conflict]]
****[[Ahmad Massoud]], who is leading the [[Panjshir resistance]] along with self-proclaimed acting president [[Amrullah Saleh]], refuses to surrender the [[Panjshir Valley]] to the [[Taliban]] and says that war is "unavoidable" if the Taliban refuse dialogue on the formation of a comprehensive [[government of Afghanistan|government]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2021/08/22/Taliban-to-face-resistance-if-they-try-to-seize-Panjishir-valley-Ahmad-Massoud (Al Arabiya)]
***[[2021 Afghan protests]]
****Hundreds of people, including Afghans, hold a demonstration against the Taliban in [[Stockholm]], [[Sweden]]. [https://www.centralasiatimes.com/news/270831103/afghans-hold-demonstration-against-taliban-in-sweden (''Central Asia Times'')]
***Taliban spokesperson [[Zabiullah Mujahid]] says that they will form a new government soon. [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/taliban-vow-to-form-a-government-quickly-tz5cdhjrl (''The Times'')]
**[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
***[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Lloyd Austin]] says that the [[United States|U.S.]] will ensure that all [[Americans|American]] citizens will be evacuated to the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]] in [[Kabul]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/ThisWeek/defense-secretary-lloyd-austin-us-means-people-kabul/story?id=79579986 (ABC News)]
***Austin also announces that the [[United States Department of Defense|U.S. Department of Defense]] will activate the [[Civil Reserve Air Fleet]] for the third time and send 18 planes that will be used by the [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. military]] to help evacuate American citizens. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/andrewsolender/2021/08/22/pentagon-commandeers-18-commercial-planes-to-help-afghanistan-evacuation/?sh=15f82e9429e7 (''Forbes'')]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] says that [[United States Armed Forces|American troops]] may remain in Afghanistan beyond the [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|August 31 deadline]]. He also announces that 11,000 people were evacuated from the country in the past 36 hours. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/joe-biden/biden-says-u-s-may-extend-afghanistan-withdrawal-deadline-evacuations-n1277414 (NBC News)]
***[[Fox News]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Suzanne Scott]] announces that the network has evacuated 24 people from Afghanistan, including three Afghan nationals who assisted with the network's coverage of the war. [https://variety.com/2021/tv/news/fox-news-afghanistan-evacuation-1235046534/ (''Variety'')]
**Aftermath of the [[Fall of Kabul (2021)|Fall of Kabul]]
***The [[Netherlands]] increases its military presence in [[Afghanistan]] to help evacuate 700 Dutch nationals and Afghan allies. Dutch foreign minister [[Sigrid Kaag]] said last Friday that multiple Afghans are eligible for evacuation to the Netherlands. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/dutch-send-more-soldiers-afghanistan-help-with-evacuations-2021-08-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Tennessee floods]]
**Heavy rains cause 21 deaths in [[Tennessee]], United States, with 45 people still missing. A record {{convert|17|inch|cm}} of rain in 24 hours was reported in [[McEwen, Tennessee|McEwen]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/08/22/us/tennessee-flooding/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brunei]]
****[[Brunei]] reports a record 314 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,769. [https://borneobulletin.com.bn/brunei-records-new-daily-high-of-314-covid-cases/ (Borneo Bulletin)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record 684 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 102,038. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/middle-east/20210822-iran-covid-deaths-at-new-daily-high-as-curbs-lifted (Radio France Internationale)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] launches [[antibody]] [[COVID-19 testing]] for 1.4 million children between the ages of 3 and 12 as part of a study to measure the extent to which COVID-19 spread undetected among children in the past 18 months. [https://www.haaretz.com/amp/israel-news/.premium-israel-kicks-off-covid-antibody-testing-of-1-4-million-children-1.10138637 (Haaretz)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports a record 737 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 8,277. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-covid-19-death-toll-reaches-737-a-new-single-day-record (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 830 new cases of COVID-19, which is the highest number reported by any [[States and territories of Australia|state or territory]] since the beginning of the pandemic. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-08-22/nsw-records-830-infections-three-deaths/100397198 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
****[[Governor of Maryland|Maryland Governor]] [[Larry Hogan]] receives his third dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. State health officials also announce that 80% of adults in [[Maryland]] have received at least one dose of the [[vaccine]]. [https://www.baltimoresun.com/coronavirus/bs-md-hogan-booster-shot-covid-vaccination-20210822-thqpgcrefza3pjp74yrfvs4s3e-story.html (''Baltimore Sun'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] receives a shipment of 400,000 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine]] donated by [[Spain]]. [https://www.perfil.com/noticias/actualidad/vacunas-argentina-ya-dispuso-de-casi-48-millones-de-dosis-de-los-cuales-aplico-39-millones.phtml (''Perfil'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Japan relations]]
**During a meeting with [[Japanese foreign minister]] [[Toshimitsu Motegi]] in [[Tehran]], [[Iranian president]] [[Ebrahim Raisi]] urged [[Japan]] to release [[United States dollar|$]]3 billion in [[Iran]]ian assets frozen in Japan due to [[international sanctions]] against Iran. [https://www.reuters.com/world/iran-urges-japan-release-billions-blocked-funds-amid-us-sanctions-2021-08-22/ (Reuters)]

*The [[far-right]] [[Proud Boys]] clash with [[Antifa (United States)|Antifa]] demonstrators at an abandoned [[Kmart (United States)|Kmart]] near downtown [[Portland, Oregon|Portland]], [[Oregon]]. [https://www.oregonlive.com/portland/2021/08/demonstrators-congregate-at-portland-waterfront.html (''The Oregonian'')]
